area: Step 3, PROCESS attributes of the v0.70.1 scan study (who listed it, screen reason shown vs hidden, minutes-to-start first listed and the 6/12/24 h trap-guard threshold, listed time/gone/last look, hour and day, price drift after the first look, placedByTj, app version/preset, CNO list and fair age, cnoOneWay), one at a time and in pairs, with game-clustered CIs, two date splits, and close-source/kind standardisation
trust_notes: UNITS: CLV, ROI in percent in prose; n_bets in findings = bets WITH a close for a CLV claim (n_games = games with a close), all bets for counts. Everything is from 2080 bets, 190 games, ~2.26 days of first-looks (Oct 3 17:56 to Oct 6 00:05 ET); only 683 bets (33%) in 69 games have a close, and the effective sample is those 69 games (9.9 closes a game). WHAT CAN BE TRUSTED: the timing result (first listed within 6 h beats the close, 6-24 h does not): it holds in all four date splits in sign, on each of the three game days, in props and game lines, in every source/hour/version slice inside the 6 h window, and after standardising for close source and kind (adjusted +1.76 [0.96, 2.74] points). WHAT CANNOT: (1) CLOSES ARE UNEVENLY SPREAD. Novig-last-trades closes (341) exist only for games of Oct 3-4 (none for first looks of Oct 5), so the loader's second date half (first look Oct 5-6, 612 bets, 100 games) has only 65 closes (all Tracker/ESPN) and 'holds on the second half' is mostly unanswerable by CLV; I therefore also split by Oct 3 first looks (D1: 373 closes) vs Oct 4-6 (D2: 310 closes) and by game day (Oct 3/4/5), and give every split. (2) THE CLOSE SOURCE CHANGES WITH TIMING. Inside 6 h: 101 Tracker + 54 ESPN + 6 Pinnacle + 95 Novig-trades closes; 6-24 h: 120 + 39 + 11 + 242. Against the soft closes (Tracker = CNO's books read before the start, ESPN = DraftKings) the 6 h gift is +2.15 [1.64, 2.80] (161 closes, 56 games); against Novig's own last trades it is only +0.15 [-0.40, 0.73] (95 closes, 35 games) and the difference to everything later is not significant there (+0.54 [-0.82, 1.87]). Pinnacle (the sharpest close) has 17 closes in all, too few to say. A Novig-trades close is a trade price, the first-listed price is the taker's price, so that source may carry a half-spread handicap (hypothesis, not verified). So the honest reading is: bets listed inside 6 h keep their edge in the books Vigilant devigs and in Tj's own tracker closes; whether that edge is against the SHARP close is not shown. (3) DRIFT, LISTED TIME, GONE, LAST-LOOK are hindsight (known only after the bet's life), so their CLV gaps are partly mechanical: they describe, they are not rules. (4) >24 h has only 15 closes in 5 games and >3 days has none (251 bets): nothing can be said about them beyond 'negative on 15'. (5) Version and preset are 14 contiguous windows (1-17 hours, most 1-3), wholly confounded with date/slate: do not read a version effect. (6) cnoOneWay is False on all 1732 CNO-sourced bets and null on the 348 Vigilant-only ones: it carries no information; and the file holds no ONE_WAY, TOO_GOOD or NOT_A_GAME rows at all. 'shown' (screen null) includes the 290 bets only Vigilant's scan listed (screen is not applicable to them); dropping them moves shown-vs-hidden from +0.87 to +1.07. MULTIPLE COMPARISONS: I looked at 105 single-attribute groups (22 attribute columns; 74 with >=30 closes), 399 pair cells with >=30 closes (66 attribute pairs of 12 dimensions), 66 adjusted level-vs-rest tests, 14 time thresholds x 10 subsets (overlapping), ~40 stratified contrasts and ~70 look-window rows: ~700 numbers, ~480 distinct tests. Of the 473 single+pair tests, 187 had a game-cluster bootstrap p<0.05 (23.7 expected under all-null) but they are strongly correlated through the one timing effect; on the 66 adjusted level-vs-rest tests, 14 distinct groups reach BH q<0.10: <=6h, <2h, 2-6h, 6-24h, the four drift groups (hindsight), version 0.59.0 and preset 'Volume + safe CLV' (the same 2.5-hour window), hour 00-05 (one day), version 0.58.0, listed 6 h+, shown. Everything but the timing result is at the level where one or two lucky/unlucky game days decide it. The bootstrap p-values are anti-conservative with 20-30 games. BIASES: CLV assumes the first-listed price was takeable (median Novig $58 at the price inside 6 h, mean $1,040; 6-24 h median $92); the study never tells what Tj's stake would have moved; same-game bets are correlated (props: ~10 bets a game); first-look time depends on when the phone was scanning (wide read at most every 30 s while the app's CNO list is read); ROI counts 1705 bets with a profit value (9 voids at 0) and is far too noisy to confirm anything (CI half-widths 6-12 points).
key_numbers: First listed within 6 h of the start: 256 closes in 66 games, CLV +1.41% [1.01, 2.00], 66.0% beat the close, ROI +4.82% [-1.28, 11.69] on 899 settled bets (77 games); 938 bets, ~416 listed a day, median Novig $58.5 at the price.

First listed 6-24 h out: 412 closes in 31 games, CLV -0.37% [-1.31, 0.43], 50.7% beat, ROI -1.36% [-8.44, 6.11] (766 settled). Over 24 h: 15 closes in 5 games, CLV -5.07% [-6.50, -0.31], ROI -15.3% on 40 settled.

Gap <=6h minus 6-24h: +1.79 [0.94, 2.71] raw, +1.76 [0.96, 2.74] standardised for close source and kind; same sign in all four date splits (first look Oct 3 +2.03 [0.81, 3.33], Oct 4-6 +0.88 [-0.69, 2.44], loader halves +1.54 [0.69, 2.50] and +3.96 [0.79, 6.06]) and on each game day (Oct 3 +1.29, Oct 4 +1.24, Oct 5 +2.29 inside 6 h).
By close source inside 6 h: Tracker/ESPN/Pinnacle closes +2.15% [1.64, 2.80] (161 closes/56 games) vs Novig-trades closes only +0.15% [-0.40, 0.73] (95/35); Pinnacle alone has 17 closes in total.

The 24 h guard: <=24h pooled CLV +0.31% [-0.21, 0.83] (668 closes/69 games) vs <=12h +1.07% [0.41, 1.95] (354/68) vs <=6h +1.41%; the 12-24 h slice -0.55% [-1.40, 0.23] (314/28 games), 6-12 h slice +0.19% [-1.44, 2.76] (98/24): 24 h is too loose, 6 h vs 12 h undecided (~170 games with closes in 6-12 h needed).
Stale listings: entering the 6 h window after 3 h+ on the list -0.04% [-0.75, 0.60] (157 bets/27 games) vs new listings +1.42% [0.94, 2.04] (265/67); gap -1.45 [-2.53, -0.64].

Price drift (hindsight): 30.8% of bets (640/2080) were later offered a longer price; those closed -1.12% [-1.89, -0.16] (298 closes/47 games) at the first price vs +1.21% [0.74, 1.70] (385/62) for the rest; best price 8%+ better later: -11.38% (18 closes). CLV at first / last / best price: +0.19 / +0.64 / +1.31.
Tj's own placed bets: inside 6 h CLV +2.39% [1.77, 3.28] (101 closes/38 games), ROI +7.4%; over 6 h out CLV -0.83% [-2.38, 0.74] (128/26) and ROI -16.38% [-27.61, -3.98] (141 settled, 26 games).

Multiple comparisons: ~480 distinct tests (105 single-attribute groups, 399 pair cells, 66 adjusted tests); only the timing effect (and hindsight drift) is robust after standardising; who listed it, hour, day, version, preset, list freshness, dropped/gone show nothing reliable.

findings.claim: TIMING IS THE DOMINANT PROCESS ATTRIBUTE: bets first listed within 6 h of the start beat the close (+1.41%); 6-24 h ones do not (-0.37%); over 24 h is a thin trap (-5.07% on 15 closes).
findings.evidence: <=6h: 938 bets/83 games, 256 closes/66 games, CLV +1.41 [1.01, 2.00], beat the close 66.0%, ROI +4.82% [-1.28, 11.69] (899 settled, 77 games). 6-24h: 811 bets, 412 closes/31 games, CLV -0.37 [-1.31, 0.43], 50.7% beat, ROI -1.36% [-8.44, 6.11] (766). >24h: 331 bets/91 games, 15 closes/5 games, CLV -5.07 [-6.50, -0.31], 27% beat, ROI -15.29% [-63.33, 15.51] (40 settled). Finer: <2h +1.42 [0.94, 2.10] (163/56 games), 2-6h +1.40 [0.72, 2.29] (93/38); every hour bin inside 6 h is positive (<30m +1.36, 30-60m +0.33 on 30 closes, 1-2h +2.28, 2-3h +1.10, 3-4h +1.70, 4-6h +1.72 on 14). Difference <=6h vs 6-24h: raw +1.79 [0.94, 2.71]; standardised for close source x kind +1.76 [0.96, 2.74]; <=6h vs everything later +1.95 [1.05, 2.92]. By game day <=6h: Oct 3 +1.29 [0.57, 2.01] (68 closes/30 games), Oct 4 +1.24 [0.73, 2.10] (150/26), Oct 5 +2.29 [1.40, 3.73] (38/10). Props <=6h +1.60 (149 closes/35 games), game lines +1.15 (107/54). Within the 6 h window it is positive for v-listed +1.04 (73), c-listed(no v) +1.67 (120), w-only +1.35 (63), shown +1.92, hidden +0.83, every first-look hour band, every version group.
findings.luck_risk: Low for the direction (same sign in all four date splits: first-look Oct 3 vs 4-6 gap +2.03 [0.81, 3.33] and +0.88 [-0.69, 2.44]; loader halves +1.54 [0.69, 2.50] and +3.96 [0.79, 6.06] on 36 vs 29 closes; three game days all positive; one of ~480 tests but survives BH q<0.01). The size is soft: ~66 games, three slates, and against Novig-trades closes the <=6h edge is only +0.15 [-0.40, 0.73] (95 closes) while against Tracker/ESPN/Pinnacle closes it is +2.15 [1.64, 2.80] (161). The second loader half has just 65 closes. About 150 more games with closes spread over several weeks and sports would settle the size.

findings.claim: THE 24 h THRESHOLD IS TOO LOOSE; 6 h and 12 h CANNOT BE SEPARATED YET. The 12-24 h slice that the 24 h guard lets through is neutral to mildly negative; over 24 h is negative.
findings.evidence: Cumulative first-listed <=T: 3h +1.35 [0.92, 1.95] (211 closes), 6h +1.41 [1.01, 2.00] (256/66 games), 12h +1.07 [0.41, 1.95] (354/68), 24h +0.31 [-0.21, 0.83] (668/69). Slices: 6-12h +0.19 [-1.44, 2.76] (98 closes/24 games, ROI -4.5% on 244), 12-24h -0.55 [-1.40, 0.23] (314/28 games, ROI +0.12% on 522), >24h -5.07 (15/5). Differences <=T vs >T: T=6h +1.95 [1.05, 2.92]; T=12h +1.83 [0.92, 2.81]; T=20h +3.29 [1.01, 5.19]; T=24h +5.38 [-0.20, 7.23] (p=0.059, only because >24h has 15 closes). At the PRICE AT THE MOMENT a bet first appears inside each window (the guard's real decision, from the looks): 0-2h +1.07 [0.71, 1.58] (321 bets/60 games), 2-6h +0.67 [0.14, 1.34] (208/40), 6-12h -0.09 [-1.18, 0.99] (258/26), 12-24h -0.72 [-1.64, 0.12] (325/29; D1 -0.77 on 279, D2 -0.44 on 46), 24h+ -5.07 (15/5); by close source the 12-24h slice is -0.71 (Novig trades, 197) and -0.74 (Tracker/ESPN/Pinnacle, 128). Entering at the first look inside T h: T=6 +0.88 [0.54, 1.29] (422 bets/67 games), T=12 +0.61 [0.02, 1.19] (558/68), T=24 +0.20 [-0.36, 0.83] (680/69). For the bets Vigilant's own scan lists (the auto-bet's pool): <=6h +1.04 [0.50, 2.24] (73 closes/20 games), <=12h +0.95 [-0.31, 2.90] (131/33), <=24h -0.05 [-0.81, 0.73] (361/39), 12-24h -0.84 [-2.09, 0.19] (236/18). Hidden bets 12-24h -1.42 [-2.45, -0.24] (123/28). The code default is 6 h (TrapGuard.DEFAULT_EARLY_HOURS, ScanSettings.trapEarlyHours; choices 0/3/6/12/24); Tj's phone ran 24 h at export (Diagnostics line 'Trap guard ... within 24 h'; its skip counters also list 6 h (303 skips) and 12 h (151) reasons, so the setting was raised over the last days).
findings.luck_risk: Moderate. The <=6h and <=12h edges and the 12-24h deficit have the same sign in D1 and D2 and in both close sources, but the 12-24h slice's own CI includes zero (28 games), and the 6-12h slice (24 games, SE ~1.07 points) cannot choose between 6 h and 12 h. To pin the 6-12 h slice to SE 0.4 points needs ~170 games with closes in that window (7x what exists; roughly 2-3 weeks of NFL-sized slates); to confirm the 12-24 h slice is negative at SE 0.25 needs ~80 games with closes (3x). Over 24 h needs ~80 closes in ~80 games to size at all (15 in 5 games now).

findings.claim: A LISTING THAT HAS BEEN UP FOR HOURS IS NOT A GIFT WHEN IT ENTERS THE 6 h WINDOW: only new listings carry the edge.
findings.evidence: Looks-based, at the first look inside the window with the bet's age = minutes since its first look. Entry <=6h: age <3h 265 bets/67 games CLV +1.42 [0.94, 2.04]; age >=3h 157 bets/27 games -0.04 [-0.75, 0.60]; gap -1.45 [-2.53, -0.64]; standardised for close source x kind -1.46 [-2.55, -0.76] (age >=1h vs <1h: -1.52 [-2.50, -0.85], 163 vs 259). Entry <=12h: new 374/68 games +1.03 [0.33, 1.84] vs stale (>=3h) 184/24 -0.25 [-0.95, 0.42]; gap -1.27 [-2.15, -0.53]. Same direction in every stratum: Novig-trades close new +0.23 (99) vs stale -0.82 (67); Tracker/ESPN/Pinnacle +2.13 (166) vs +0.55 (90); props +1.59 vs -0.04; game lines +1.18 vs -0.02. Date splits: D1 (first look Oct 3) new +1.21 (76) vs stale -0.39 (106); D2 new +1.50 (189) vs stale +0.70 (51, thin). By age inside the <=6h window: 0-1m +1.41 (256), 1-10m +1.47, 10-30m +1.64, 30-60m +2.01 (62), 1-3h +1.57 (69), 3-10h -0.21 (63), 10h+ +0.14 (122). The hindsight version agrees: listed 6h+ -1.38 [-2.47, -0.19] (144 closes/24 games), adjusted -1.28 [-2.07, -0.25] (BH q=0.077); inside 6-24h listed 6h+ -1.02 [-1.96, -0.09] (134) vs 1-6h +0.16 (159).
findings.effect: stale (listed >=3 h) minus new: -1.45% [-2.53, -0.64] at the <=6 h window; stale -0.04% [-0.75, 0.60]
findings.luck_risk: Moderate: sign holds in D1 and D2 and in all four strata, but the stale group is only 27 games (D2: 51 bets), it rests on a hindsight-free but post-selected construction (bets still listed), and it was one of ~25 looks-based cuts. ~100 more games with stale entries would settle it.

findings.claim: TJ'S OPEN QUESTION, HIDDEN BETS: the screened-out bets are not traps inside 6 h (they are positive, about half as good as shown ones); they are mildly negative at 6-24 h and negative over 24 h; the EV floor is where almost all of them are lost.
findings.evidence: shown 803 bets/148 games: 384 closes/60 games CLV +0.57 [-0.20, 1.40], 59.1% beat, ROI -0.08% [-7.81, 6.67] (685). hidden 1277 bets/135 games: 299 closes/49 games CLV -0.30 [-0.83, 0.36], 51.8% beat, ROI +2.69% [-2.94, 9.71] (1020). Gap shown-hidden: raw +0.87 [0.07, 1.71] (p=0.032); standardised for timing x close source x kind +1.11 [0.17, 2.17] (p=0.017, BH q=0.077); without the 290 v-listed 'shown' +1.25 [0.22, 2.26]; D1 +0.89 (adj +1.33 [-0.23, 2.81]), D2 +1.28 [0.05, 2.58] (adj +1.41 [0.36, 2.56]), H1 +0.98 [0.14, 1.80], H2 +0.11 on 30 vs 35 closes. Within a window: <=6h shown +1.92 [1.31, 2.73] (136 closes/54 games) vs hidden +0.83 [0.42, 1.38] (120/44); 6-24h shown +0.01 [-1.16, 1.00] (242/25) vs hidden -0.92 [-1.74, -0.03] (170/29); >24h hidden -3.57 (9 closes), shown -7.31 (6). By reason: EV (955 bets; 253 closes/46 games) -0.29 [-0.83, 0.36] and <=6h hidden-EV +0.56 [0.25, 0.96] (98 closes/38 games; D1 +1.10 on 33, D2 +0.28 on 65, listed EV +0.36%); BOOKS 147 bets/13 closes -2.24; ODDS 127/18 +0.29; NOT_LISTED 32/12 +0.80; MISMATCH 16/3 -0.18: the four non-EV reasons have 3-18 closes and cannot be judged. Hidden ROI is higher (+2.69% vs -0.08%) but that is inside its CI (+-6 points): luck. Listed EV: shown +2.31%, hidden +0.54% (EV-hidden +0.36%): the shown/hidden CLV gap is roughly the listed-EV gap.
findings.effect: shown minus hidden CLV: +0.87 [0.07, 1.71] raw, +1.11 [0.17, 2.17] standardised; hidden <=6h +0.83 [0.42, 1.38]
findings.luck_risk: Moderate for 'shown > hidden by about 1 point' (sign in D1, D2, H1, both windows; nominal p 0.017-0.04, one of ~25 contrasts, BH q=0.077; H2 too thin). Low for any single hidden reason (3-18 closes each). Hidden-EV bets inside 6 h look like +0.5% CLV bets, too small to say at ~100 closes; ~300 closes in ~100 games would settle whether lowering the EV floor is worth anything (a loosening: a question for Tj, not an action).

findings.claim: WHO LISTED IT (CNO / Vigilant / wide read) DOES NOT MATTER ONCE TIMING IS HELD FIXED.
findings.luck_risk: The raw gap looks real (p 0.04) and is not: it disappears once timing is held fixed. Treat as no difference; ~300 closes per source inside the 6 h window would be needed to see a 0.5-point difference.

findings.claim: PRICE DRIFT AFTER THE FIRST LOOK (hindsight): bets whose price later got longer (better for the bettor) closed worse than their first price; bets whose price got shorter closed better. Descriptive, not a rule.
findings.evidence: 30.8% of bets (640/2080) were later listed at a longer price than the first look; 25.1% (522) ended longer than first, 56.2% (1169) same, 18.7% (389) ended shorter. Share with a later better price: <=6h 20.3%, 6-24h 40.8%, >24h 36.0%. CLV at the first price: best-price-later-longer 298 closes/47 games -1.12 [-1.89, -0.16], ROI -6.87% [-14.6, 1.95] (525) vs best-same 385/62 +1.21 [0.74, 1.70], ROI +5.33% [1.03, 10.12] (1180); standardised gap -2.26 [-3.25, -1.29]. Ending longer 237 closes -1.88 [-2.73, -0.86] vs ending same 266 +0.85 [0.36, 1.35] vs ending shorter 180 +1.94 [1.19, 2.93] (shorter-minus-same standardised +1.41 [0.41, 2.72]). Dose-response: best price 2-4% longer -0.51 (91 closes), 4-8% -3.39 [-4.60, -2.02] (37/16 games), 8%+ -11.38 [-15.57, -7.75] (18/11); last price 4%+ shorter +5.13 [2.18, 9.44] (16/14), 2-4% shorter +2.34 (31), 4%+ longer -6.52 [-8.00, -4.82] (46/20). Mean CLV at first / last / best listed price over the 683 closes: +0.19 / +0.64 / +1.31. At the LATER price the same bets still beat the close: ended-longer bets clvLast +0.71 vs ended-same +0.85. Gap holds by halves: best-longer vs best-same D1 -1.97 (123) vs +0.78 (198), D2 +0.09 (175) vs +1.66 (187). Inside <=6h: -> best-longer +0.36 [-0.28, 1.37] (80) vs same +1.89 [1.45, 2.43] (176). Resting-bid simulation (a bid d under the first price fills when the offer reaches it): d=1% fills 28.7% of bets (196 of 683) with CLV at fill +0.83 [-0.18, 2.01] vs +0.99 [0.58, 1.45] at first price for the 487 never-filled; d=2% fills 21.1% at +0.81 vs +0.94 for the never-filled; inside <=6h d=1% fills 20.3% (52 bets) at +2.31 vs +1.82 for the never-filled.
findings.luck_risk: The direction is partly mechanical (the later price carries the news that moves the close; a bet cannot be filtered on it at the first look). The sizes hold on both date halves and in both timing windows, but this cannot be turned into an ex-ante rule from this file. The resting-bid result is weak: waiting for a 1% better price misses the 71% of bets that never get there, which average +0.99 at the first price.

findings.claim: HOUR OF DAY AND DAY: no replicable effect; the hour is a proxy for time-to-start and for the slate.
findings.effect: no hour band stays significant after standardising except 00-05 (+2.43 [0.63, 4.25], one day)
findings.luck_risk: High for any single hour/day claim: 20+ hour/day cells, each 9-30 games, the 00-05 and 03:00 cells come from one night. Day-1 vs later is confounded with the app version (0.57-0.58.4) and the Novig-trades closes.

findings.claim: APP VERSION AND PRESET: cannot be separated from date and slate; no version effect is claimed.
findings.evidence: 14 versions, each in force for one contiguous window (1-17 hours, most 1-3), only six with >=48 closes: 0.57.0 +0.34 (70 closes), 0.58.0 -0.85 (93), 0.58.2 -0.18 (144), 0.58.3 -1.89 [-3.93, -0.06] (55), 0.59.0 +2.22 [0.70, 4.07] (74/20 games), 0.59.1 +0.93 [0.09, 1.88] (119/25), 0.60.0 +0.61 (48), 0.61.0 -1.24 (32), 0.66/0.67/0.68.0 +2.55/+1.91/+2.41 (17/6/10 closes), 0.68.1 and 0.70.1 no closes. Grouped: V1 (0.57-0.58.4, Oct 3) -1.68 raw, -1.62 adjusted [-3.49, 0.00] (377 closes) vs V2 (0.59-0.60) +1.26 (241); V4 (0.66-0.70) +2.39 on 33. Preset: '2 (Safe CLV)' 1873 bets/599 closes +0.15 [-0.44, 0.81]; 'Volume + safe CLV' 60 bets/33 closes +1.65 [0.59, 2.64] (all inside version 0.59.0: same window as its +2.22); '5 (Super CLV all markets)' 59 bets/28 closes -1.52 [-5.29, 1.39]; '(changed)' variants 21 and 1 closes; preset '3' (8 bets) 2 closes in all. Each version is one contiguous window (1-17 hours, most 1-3), so version is date.
findings.effect: no estimable version or preset effect
findings.luck_risk: Not testable here: version windows do not overlap in time. A version effect would need the same slate under two settings, which this file cannot give.

findings.claim: FRESHNESS OF THE LISTS (CNO list age, Vigilant's fair age): no sign that fresher is better; if anything the opposite on the CNO list.
findings.luck_risk: Likely noise: the CNO result runs against its intuition and fails the BH cut (q=0.13); the fair-age result is 58 closes in a few games. Ages are all fresh (CNO list median 6 s), so there is almost no variation to test.

findings.claim: TJ'S OWN PLACED BETS: the trap guard's origin shows up again; his bets placed more than 6 h before the start lost at the first-listed price.
findings.evidence: placedByTj 245 bets/49 games: 229 closes (all Tracker) CLV +0.59 [-0.36, 1.61], 66.4% beat, ROI -6.34% [-16.19, 4.35] (244 settled); not placed 1835 bets CLV -0.01 [-0.60, 0.65] (454 closes). Placed <=6h: 103 bets/38 games CLV +2.39 [1.77, 3.28] (101 closes, 78% beat), ROI +7.40% [-11.30, 29.29]; placed >6h out 142 bets/27 games CLV -0.83 [-2.38, 0.74] (128 closes), ROI -16.38% [-27.61, -3.98] (141 settled, 26 games). Placed minus not placed, standardised +0.27 [-2.88, 1.48] (no selection edge beyond timing: 225 vs 113 matched closes). Mean American price Tj actually took +77.9 vs +74.2 first-listed (he did not take worse prices on average).
findings.luck_risk: ROI -16.4% on 141 bets in 26 games has a CI excluding zero but is one of many looks at ROI; the CLV sign holds in both date splits: placed <=6h D1 +2.24 (24 closes) and D2 +2.43 (77); placed >6h D1 -0.76 (79) and D2 -0.94 (49). It matches the v0.54.0 finding that created the guard (176 bets: <6h +2.2%, 6h+ -0.6%).

findings.claim: HOW LONG IT STAYED LISTED, WHETHER A SCAN DROPPED IT, AND HOW CLOSE TO THE START ITS LAST LOOK WAS: no usable signal beyond the timing it already encodes (all hindsight).
findings.effect: dropped minus still listed: -0.18 raw [-1.20, 1.18]; listed 6h+ -1.38 [-2.47, -0.19]
findings.luck_risk: Mostly the timing effect seen through long listings; the adjusted listed-6h+ gap (-1.28, q=0.077) is the only piece that is not clearly explained by it and it is hindsight. The forward-looking version is the age finding above.

findings.claim: cnoOneWay IS A CONSTANT: there is nothing to analyse, and the file has no ONE_WAY / TOO_GOOD / NOT_A_GAME rows.
findings.evidence: ab_cnoOneWay is False on all 1732 CNO-sourced bets and missing on the 348 Vigilant-only ones. screen takes only EV (955), BOOKS (147), ODDS (127), NOT_LISTED (32), MISMATCH (16) and null (803): none of the screens the READ ME lists as ONE_WAY, TOO_GOOD, NOT_A_GAME occurs, so either the wide read never returns those rows or none appeared in 2.26 days.
findings.luck_risk: Not a statistical question: it is a gap in what the log records (see next_logging).

findings.claim: COUNT OF COMPARISONS AND WHAT SURVIVES: timing is the only process attribute with a robust, standardised, multiply-split effect; hindsight drift groups are strong but not rules; everything else is at noise level.
findings.evidence: Single-attribute groups 105 (74 with >=30 closes): 24 with p<0.05 (3.7 expected under all-null), 17 with p<0.01, 18 at BH q<0.05 (22 at q<0.10): <2h, 2-6h, <=6h, the drift groups, 0.59.0/V2/V4 versions, Oct 4 first-look day, lister_v False, c-listed(no v), hour 23, hour 3, 13-16, c+w, cnoAge>10s, Volume preset, listed 6h+. After standardising for timing x close source x kind the survivors (BH q<0.10 of 66 adjusted tests) shrink to: <=6h (+2.00 [1.12, 3.08]), <2h (+1.52), 2-6h (+1.34), 6-24h (-1.22 [-2.29, -0.35]), the drift groups, v0.59.0 (+3.25, one 2.5-hour window), preset Volume (same window), hour 00-05 (+2.43, one night), v0.58.0 (-1.30), listed 6h+ (-1.28), shown (+1.11). Negatives with p<0.05 in the raw singles: hour 23 (-2.24), listed 6h+ (-1.38), best-longer (-1.12), last-longer (-1.88), v0.58.3 (-1.89, 55 closes). GIFTS (>=150 closes, positive on both date halves): only 'first listed <=6h' (256 closes) and its sub-windows; with ~136-150 closes, 'shown & <=6h' (+1.92 [1.31, 2.73], D1 +1.33 on 36, D2 +2.13 on 100). TRAPS (clearly negative): only 'first listed >24h' (15 closes, 5 games, thin) and, hindsight, 'price ended longer' (237 closes); nothing else is clearly negative with >=150 closes (6-24h overall -0.37 is not).
findings.luck_risk: Nominal p-values from a game-cluster bootstrap are anti-conservative at 20-30 games; with ~480 distinct tests and ~24 nominal single-attribute hits, expect a handful of false positives among everything except the timing effect.

candidate_rules.name: GIFT: first listed within 6 h of the start
candidate_rules.rationale: The only process attribute that separates good from bad: bets first listed inside 6 h beat the close; holds on every date split and on both close types in sign (vs tracker/ESPN/Pinnacle closes +2.15, vs Novig-trades closes only +0.15). This is the trap guard at 6 h (the code default, TrapGuard.DEFAULT_EARLY_HOURS).

candidate_rules.name: first listed within 3 h of the start
candidate_rules.rationale: Tighter window: same CLV as 6 h on fewer bets (no gain from going tighter than 6 h).

candidate_rules.name: first listed within 12 h of the start
candidate_rules.rationale: Middle option: keeps the 6-12 h slice (98 closes, CLV +0.19, CI -1.44 to +2.76: undecided) and drops the 12-24 h slice.

app_changes_implied: PROPOSAL (tightening, so not a loosening): Settings › Scanning / ScanSettings.trapEarlyHours (data/scanner/ScanSettings.kt ~l.372; TrapGuard.EARLY_CHOICES 0/3/6/12/24; TrapGuard.DEFAULT_EARLY_HOURS = 6). The phone ran 24 h at export. The data suggests 6 h (the code default) beats 24 h: <=6h +1.41% [1.01, 2.00] (256 closes/66 games) vs <=24h +0.31% [-0.21, 0.83] (668/69), the 12-24 h slice the 24 h setting admits is -0.55% [-1.40, 0.23] (314/28) and the price at the moment those bets first appear is -0.72% [-1.64, 0.12] (325/29), ROI of the 6-24 h bets -1.36% [-8.44, 6.11]. For the auto-bet's own pool the same cut is <=6h +1.04% [0.50, 2.24] (73/20) vs <=24h -0.05% [-0.81, 0.73] (361/39). It would cost (938 vs 1749 listed bets) about 360 listed bets a day of the ~775. Ask Tj; 6 h vs 12 h is undecided (6-12 h slice +0.19% [-1.44, 2.76], 98 closes/24 games) and needs ~170 games with closes in that window.

PROPOSAL (tightening): add a 'fresh listing' condition to the auto-bet / alerts / bids inside the guard window: skip a bet the study journal first saw >=3 h earlier (data/study StudyJournal firstSeenMs is already stored per bet; the guard already knows the start time). Evidence: at entry <=6h, listings 3 h+ old -0.04% [-0.75, 0.60] (157 bets/27 games) vs new +1.42% [0.94, 2.04] (265/67), gap -1.45 [-2.53, -0.64]; cuts ~37% of entries. Needs Tj's decision and ~100 more games with stale entries to confirm.

NO CHANGE PROPOSED to CNO's filters (EV floor 1%, odds cap +150, 4+ books, rows 100): hidden bets inside 6 h are positive but small (+0.83% [0.42, 1.38], 120 closes/44 games; EV-floor-hidden +0.56% [0.25, 0.96], 98/38, listed EV +0.36%) and negative at 6-24 h (-0.92% [-1.74, -0.03], 170/29): the filters cost little and save a little. Lowering a floor would be a loosening and a question for Tj only after ~300 closes of hidden-EV bets inside 6 h.

OPTIONAL (display only): Settings › Scanning › Starts within (v0.61.0 offers 3 h / 6 h) set to 6 h for the lists would match the guard (the Diagnostics health hint 'Early bets (CLV)' points at 24 h today).
Do NOT build rules on price drift, listed time, 'gone' or last-look time: they are hindsight. The fresh-listing proposal above is the forward-looking form of listed time.
Presets / versions: no preset or version difference can be claimed from this file; keep the 'Safe CLV' preset as is (nothing in the process attributes argues for a different one).
